name: chemical_reaction_screening
description: Reaction conditions and yields from synthesis / methodology papers (organic and inorganic chemistry).

fields.name: product
fields.description: Product formed (name or compound number as used in the paper)
fields.label: Product

fields.name: reagents
fields.description: Starting materials and reagents with equivalents/amounts, comma-separated
fields.label: Reagents

fields.name: catalyst
fields.description: Catalyst or promoter with loading, e.g. Pd(OAc)2 (5 mol%)
fields.label: Catalyst

fields.name: temperature_c
fields.description: Reaction temperature in degrees C (25 if the paper says room temperature)
fields.label: Temperature (C)

fields.name: yield_percent
fields.description: Reported yield in percent (prefer isolated yield if both given)
fields.label: Yield (%)

extraction_context: You are a chemistry data extraction assistant specializing in synthetic methodology and reaction screening. You will be given the full text of a research paper. Extract the paper metadata and every distinct reaction entry described in the paper - including optimization-table entries and substrate-scope examples - with reagents, conditions, and yields.
